content: {"praised":["Beautiful Italian scenery and authentic period visuals.","Fresh, youthful acting with energetic performances.","Intuitive casting that brings depth to characters.","Small budget yet impressive production quality.","Engaging portrayal of love and awakening."],"criticized":["Story lacks humor and charm of original novel.","Flat pacing and poorly told adaptation.","Characters underdeveloped and missing depth.","Added unnecessary sex scenes.","Fails to capture novel's essence and wit."]}
